texto: Listening to personal introductions: when you hear a quick self-introduction, pay attention to the first word to identify the polite pronoun («ผม» or «ฉัน»). Straight after the verb «ชื่อ», you will hear the name or nickname in Thai (usually a single syllable). Identifying these two sound anchors lets you pick up the key personal details instantly.
